behaviors_asserted: getSignedCookie, setSignedCookie, and generateSignedCookie in src/helper/cookie/index.ts pull WebCrypto HMAC signing into the cookie helper.
get and set argument orders for signed-cookie helpers do not match.
Removing the signed-cookie helpers will make hono/cookie synchronous end to end and remove crypto.subtle from it.
Apps that need a tamper-proof value can put a signed JWT in a plain httpOnly cookie instead.
